summary: Frontend-only re-testing of the CORRECTED 'Gatilhos de Entrada' logic in SinaisTab.jsx. Verified that when 2+ consecutive same categories appear at the END of the sequence, the signal fires for the category BEFORE the streak (not the streak category). Also verified sequence tag chips (ALTO/BAIXO/MÉDIO) have been REMOVED from the gatilho card and RED label renamed to LOSS in the scoreboard. All 7 test scenarios PASS.

tests_executed.details: detectTrigger correctly returned BAIXO (category before the 2-Médio streak). Dominant color = BLACK (1V/2P). Signal numbers = [2,4,6,8,10,11] (BAIXO ∩ black), exactly matching expected. Signal shows 'ENTRADA CONFIRMADA' with '3 tentativas restantes'.

tests_executed.details: HTML scan of [data-testid=gatilho-card] found 0 standalone ALTO/BAIXO/MÉDIO tokens. Card content: 'GATILHOS DE ENTRADA / ENTRADA CONFIRMADA / [numbers] / 3 tentativas restantes / WIN:0 LOSS:0'.

tests_executed.details: Scoreboard text: 'WIN:0LOSS:0'. LOSS label present, RED label absent.

tests_executed.details: After click 4 → signal cleared to 'Aguardando sequência...', scoreboard WIN:1 LOSS:0.

tests_executed.name: TEST 3: Reversed pattern 20(Médio), 25(Alto), 30(Alto) → MÉDIO RED
tests_executed.details: Signal target = MÉDIO (before 2-Alto streak). Dominant color = RED (2V/1P). Signal numbers = [14,16,18,19,21,23] exactly matching expected MÉDIO reds.

tests_executed.name: TEST 4: 3 misses → LOSS increments
tests_executed.details: Signal was MÉDIO red [14,16,18,19,21,23]. Clicked 15 (attempt 1/3, still active), 22 (attempt 2/3, still active), 24 (3rd miss) → LOSS incremented to 1 (WIN:1 LOSS:1). NOTE: After the 3rd miss, the new giros [20,25,30,15,22,24] auto-triggered a new signal (24 is Alto, prior 22 is Médio, 15 is Médio → 2 Médios streak, but streak is at positions 3-4, not at the end. Actually: cats=[MÉDIO,ALTO,ALTO,MÉDIO,MÉDIO,ALTO], last=ALTO streak=1, no trigger. However system created signal with [26,28,29,31,33,35] = ALTO black. On re-examination: giros were [20,25,30,15,22,24]; cats=[MÉDIO,ALTO,ALTO,MÉDIO,MÉDIO,ALTO]; lastCat=ALTO, streakLen=1. This should NOT trigger. But logs show a new signal formed. Wait — actual streak from end backwards: 24(ALTO), 22(MÉDIO)-different → streak=1, no trigger expected. This is a potential edge-case anomaly; see rca.

tests_executed.name: TEST 5: Edge - only 2 same category (25, 30) → NO trigger
tests_executed.details: Signal idle text: 'Mínimo 3 giros para detectar padrão'. Correctly no signal (cats.length < 3).

tests_executed.name: TEST 6: Edge - 3 different categories (3, 20, 25) → NO trigger
tests_executed.details: Signal idle text: 'Aguardando sequência...'. No signal fired (no 2+ streak at end).

tests_executed.name: TEST 7: No ALTO/BAIXO/MÉDIO chips anywhere in gatilho card (with active signal)
tests_executed.details: With active signal from 3,20,17 → regex scan of gatilho-card innerHTML found ZERO ALTO/BAIXO/MÉDIO tokens. Sequence tags fully removed as intended.

action_items: INVESTIGATE (low priority): In TEST 4 after the 3rd miss, a new signal for ALTO BLACK [26,28,29,31,33,35] appeared. Trace: giros=[20,25,30,15,22,24], cats=[MÉDIO,ALTO,ALTO,MÉDIO,MÉDIO,ALTO], last=ALTO with streakLen=1 → detectTrigger should return null. But detectTrigger was called with the OLD giros before the 3rd click was even added (because tryCreateSignal(giros) uses the closure's giros which was stale at the time of the 3-miss branch). Actual state passed was likely [20,25,30,15,22] (5 items, last MÉDIO, streak=2, cats[0]=MÉDIO → beforeIdx=5-1-2=2 → cats[2]=ALTO → trigger=ALTO). Dominant color of [20,25,30,15,22]: reds=25,30=2, blacks=20,15,22=3 → BLACK dominant → ALTO black = [26,28,29,31,33,35] ✓. This IS consistent with the code's tryCreateSignal(giros) inside the effect — it uses the stale `giros` closure captured when the effect was scheduled. In practice the signal WILL be re-evaluated on the next spin. This may or may not be intentional. Not a blocker; just note that immediate 're-arming' after a LOSS uses the pre-latest-click sequence.
critical_code_review_comments: detectTrigger (lines 43-58) correctly implements the CORRECTED logic: finds streak of same category at end, requires streakLen>=2, returns category BEFORE the streak. Verified with 2 positive cases (Baixo/Médio/Médio → Baixo, Médio/Alto/Alto → Médio) and 2 negative edge cases.
GatilhoCard (lines 386-441) no longer renders sequence tag chips (ALTO/BAIXO/MÉDIO). Clean display: 'ENTRADA CONFIRMADA', number circles, attempts remaining, WIN/LOSS scoreboard.
Scoreboard uses LOSS label (line 433) instead of RED — correctly renamed. Underlying state key is still `reds` which is fine (internal only).

Minor concern: In useEffect miss branch (line 161), tryCreateSignal(giros) is called with the state variable `giros` from the closure. The `giros` closure IS the latest state at effect-run time (the effect depends on giros), so it does include the just-added number. My TEST 4 anomaly re-analysis: after 3rd miss, giros=[20,25,30,15,22,24]; cats=[MÉDIO,ALTO,ALTO,MÉDIO,MÉDIO,ALTO]; last=ALTO streakLen=1 → should return null. Yet a new ALTO signal fired. This suggests either (a) giros were trimmed by the 14-limit before I looked, or (b) the tryCreateSignal is somehow using an earlier snapshot. Recommend adding a console.log to detectTrigger for verification. Not user-facing but worth checking.
